title: BabyCat — Catalog Management & AI-Assisted Rules Engine
metadata: 2026 | Project owner and architect; AI-assisted development | Independent project
bullets: Multi-tenant platform: Python, JavaScript, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Blob Storage; RBAC, versioning, audit trails.
AST-based DSL: transformations, validation, aggregation, formatting, governance; execution caching and indexed composite-key lookups.
OpenRouter AI rule generation: schema-grounded prompts, structured outputs, clarification, DSL validation, human review.
Interactive data workbench: change visualization, DSL filtering, cell-level provenance, syntax highlighting, dependency graphs and impact analysis.
OAuth API, SFTP and webhook imports; reference tables; multi-destination exports, approval gates, durable queues and duplicate protection.
232 automated tests; end-to-end pipelines, desktop/mobile browser checks, tenant isolation and retry recovery.
